title: Change Of Awareness
paragraphs: After leveling up Assistant, Rival, and Mole to a certain extent, the time for the Wave in Melromarc was approaching. Father and the others planned not to suppress it immediately but to let some time pass, allowing the residents to fully experience the terror of the Wave before stepping in to help.

The real problem is the escape, isn’t it? Since this Wave will occur near Riyute Village, close to the castle, taking too much time will allow the knights to arrive. Additionally, the issue with teleportation is that it can be disrupted if there is a high-level magic field, such as a ritual-class spell.
“So? Motoyasu, how long after the Wave starts will the knights arrive?”
“Since it’s nearby, I recall reinforcements arriving in about thirty minutes.”
“If they attack, should we hold them off while going easy on them?”
“Quickly suppressing the Wave and escaping is an option, but…”
“That wouldn’t allow them to experience the true threat of the Wave.”
“I’m sorry… even though it’s our own country’s problem.”
Éclair bowed her head toward Father and the others as they discussed.
“Well… I suppose the issue is that the Waves happened to emerge in the wrong place.”

This was a region with a high population of demi-humans in a country known for its demi-human exclusion policies. Originally, it was meant to be a place of friendship, yet no one could have foreseen that it would suffer such devastating damage. A disaster in a land that felt distant from them… To the citizens, it must have seemed like nothing more than a calamity befalling enemy territory.

“For now, we’ll protect the village until the designated time. Once it arrives, we’ll swiftly take down the boss. After that, we’ll wipe out the remaining monsters with area skills and retreat. The rest will be left to the locals and the knights.”
“There’s no other choice, huh? But… even if it’s for the world’s sake, a country that does things like this deserves to fall.”
“That’s something we agreed not to say. Well, as long as they come to understand, that’s enough.”
“Motoyasu, the location is near Riyute Village, and the boss is a Chimera, right?”
“Without a doubt!”

Father and the others carefully went over their strategy, even calculating their escape route. If it were me, I’d just use a skill to obliterate the boss along with the Wave’s rift and escape instantly.
“Honestly, targeting a specific moment like this feels wrong.”
“I understand. The me in Motoyasu’s stories did something similar and failed.”
“But the people of Melromarc have no sense of crisis regarding the Wave. I have no choice but to convince myself that this is a necessary evil.”
“Yeah… you’re right.”
Father and the others seemed to accept the plan itself, but they still had some reluctance about carrying it out.
“It’s time.”
As we were discussing, the moment had arrived.
“Sakura will do her best!”
“I will do my best too!”
“Kou too!”
The Filolials were as energetic as ever.
“Gaau! U, na…”
“You’re getting close to speaking human language, aren’t you?”
“They can talk?”
“Yeah.”
Assistant, Rival, and Mole continued chatting cheerfully. They followed behind Father.

“When we teleport, let’s make sure we stay out of sight and observe the situation. Once we confirm that the monsters are attacking the village, we’ll jump in. Then, while protecting the villagers, we’ll take down the boss as quickly as possible and retreat afterward.”
“I understand.”
“Normally, we shouldn’t just stand by and watch, but if they don’t experience the danger firsthand, they won’t understand the threat.”
Problems keep surfacing, don’t they?
“Alright… let’s go!”
Almost at the exact moment Éclair spoke, the countdown to the Wave hit zero. As expected, we teleported near Riyute Village. How many times have I experienced these Waves by now?

The first time, I charged in recklessly, focused only on the boss… The second time, I fought alongside Father to protect the village… And now, this is the third time. Until now, Ren and Itsuki had done nothing but charge in blindly like fools, but this time, they were quietly observing.
“So that’s… the Wave…”
“It was replicated in game quests, but seeing it in reality is overwhelming.”
“They’re appearing one after another. I want to rush in and take down the boss as soon as possible, but…”
“Just like we planned… but at this pace, it’s getting intense. It’s about time we jumped in!”
“Understood!”
I took the lead, riding on Yuki-chan.
“Gaelion, go!”
“Gaou!”
Assistant and Mole followed behind, riding on Rival. Since Rival has a breath attack that covers a wide area, it’s highly effective against the monsters this time.
“Father, take the front line! I’ll hang back and use my skills!”
“Got it! Itsuki, focus on taking out the monsters heading for the village!”
“Understood! I’ll control their numbers!”
“I’ll fight as well! Iwatani-dono, I leave the frontline to you!”
“Don’t worry… I’ll protect everyone.”

We rushed together toward the Dimensional Chimera and its monsters. With the swift Filolials on our side, we covered the distance quickly. The last time, we had to destroy the village fence to prevent damage to the Filolial ranch. But this time, we’re aiming to control the situation better and minimize damage.
“Aiming Lancer X!”
We wiped out the monsters that seemed like they might head toward the Filolial ranch in advance.
“Wow… that’s an incredible sight.”
“Overwhelming firepower… as expected of the Hero.”
“The falling lances look just like an aerial bombardment.”
These Wave monsters are nothing more than small fry. The Chimera, too, is mostly for show—it’s not that strong.
“Keep the number of monsters just barely manageable for the defense line….”

Letting just enough monsters slip through toward the village is surprisingly tricky. Last time, we had to hide our strength, but this time, we need to show the citizens just how dangerous the Wave truly is. There are some screams coming from the village, but the damage so far is minimal.
… Dimensional Locusts, Dimensional Lesser Wasps, and Dimensional Ghouls all raised their weapons against Father, but he didn’t even flinch. By now, a massive horde of monsters had swarmed around him.
“Ugh… this is kind of unsettling. In an MMO, this would be like a train, where monsters are being pulled around. If someone dumped them onto another player, it’d be a perfect MPK.”
“Uh… Naofumi, my skill might hit you, is that okay?” Ren asked hesitantly.
Ah, well, with Ren’s gaming knowledge, he probably assumes it’s impossible to endure. Both Itsuki and I share the same understanding, so Itsuki also looks at me and Father, unsure of what to do.
“He’s completely surrounded, and yet he’s just standing there like it’s nothing…”
“Either way, can you guys hurry up and take them down?”
“Gau!”
“Alright! Gaelion, go for it!”
Assistant commanded Rival to unleash a breath of fire from above, engulfing Father.
“Sakura won’t lose either! Zwei Tornado!”
Sakura-chan’s magic combined with the flames, creating a fiery tornado centered around Father. In an instant, the monsters were set ablaze, turning the entire area into a sea of fire.
“Uh… well, thanks, I guess.”
Father swiped his cape through the fiery tornado, dispersing the flames, and turned back toward us.
“That was amazing. For a moment, Naofumi-san actually looked kind of cool.”
“Yeah, something about the way he’s standing there with flames around him… kind of badass. It makes me jealous that the Shield Hero can take all that without a scratch.”
“Not sure why you’d admire me for this… I don’t even have a way to fight back. Besides—”
“GRAAAAAAAAAAAAH!”
The Chimera leapt through the blazing storm, pouncing toward Father. But he caught it head-on.
“My options for counterattacks are pretty limited. Ren, Itsuki, Motoyasu-kun—everyone, I’m counting on you!”
Father braced himself and, with full force, hurled the Chimera away.
“Leave it to me! Eclair, let’s go! Meteor Sword! Air Strike Bash!”
“Understood! Haaaah!”
Ren and Éclair coordinated their attacks, slashing the airborne Chimera mid-flight. Their strike severed one of its arms.
“I’m not done yet! Meteor Bow!”
Before the Chimera could hit the ground, Itsuki’s arrow struck it, launching it back into the air.
“Gaelion! Imiya-chan, together—”
“Got it!”
“Gau!”
Assistant and Mole worked together to cast a spell. Rival unleashed a fireball breath, scorching the Chimera.
“Sakura won’t lose!”
“Neither will I!”
“Me too!”
The Filolials charged toward the Chimera, each landing powerful kicks that sent it flying even higher into the air. Using their bodies as stepping stones, the Chimera was propelled higher and higher.
“Time to finish it off.”
“Motoyasu-kun, remember we need materials from it, so don’t overdo it.”
“I know that.”
Ah, I almost forgot. The Chimera is already on the verge of death, but I’ll be the one to finish it.
